analysis: The jump from 0.33 to about 0.998 came from three changes together: 4 PPO epochs with at least 4 minibatches, lr of 1e-3 or more with gamma 0.99, and layernorm with success_bonus 5. Recipes with too few updates fall to about 0.72 (t05, t07, t09). The same failure can also hit a single seed: depth 3 at lr 0.002 scored 1.0, 0.996 and 0.738 (t25), so t22's tied top score of 1.0 belongs to a fragile recipe. Depth 2 with layernorm is 7 of 7 good: lr 1e-3 gave 0.998 three times (0.996 with 8 minibatches), lr 0.002 gave 1.0, 0.998 and 0.994, and lr 0.003 gave 0.998. It also takes about 190 s. This last round adds depth-2 seeds so the robust, cheap recipe has the most evidence behind it.

proposals.hypothesis: Exact repeat of t17 (depth 2, lr 0.002), run only to measure noise, giving this tied-top candidate a fourth seed. A score of 0.994 or higher supports selecting it over the fragile depth-3 lr 0.002 recipe; a collapse to about 0.7 means depth 2 can also fail on some seeds.

Exact repeat of t11/t12/t19 (depth 2, lr 1e-3), run only to measure noise with a fourth seed. Another 0.996 or higher confirms it as the lowest-variance recipe; a drop below 0.98 means it is seed-fragile too.

Depth 2 at lr 0.0015, in the middle of the depth-2 plateau (lr 1e-3 to 3e-3 all scored 0.994 or higher), should be the least sensitive to seed and may reach 1.0. A score below 0.994 means the plateau is noisier than it looks.

Exact repeat of t23 (depth 2, lr 0.003), run only to measure noise at the upper lr edge. If it scores 0.996 or higher, the depth-2 plateau is wide and lr 0.002 is safely inside it; a collapse means high lr can trigger the about-0.7 failure, which favours lr 1e-3.
